items.title: India Based Neutrino Observatory Story
items.description:
Neutrino: An electrically neutral elementary particle that interacts very weakly with matter.

INO: The India-based Neutrino Observatory, a proposed underground neutrino research facility in India.

ICAL: A proposed 50,000-tonne Magnetised Iron Calorimeter detector designed to study atmospheric neutrinos and antineutrinos.

Neutrino mass ordering: The question of how the three neutrino mass states are arranged relative to one another.

Story characters Dadu and Bapi are fictional. The scientific project and its research goals are based on real-world science. The project's current status should be verified before publication.

Tarar Golpo • Issue 1 • The Mountain That Waits
